product_one_liner.value: Malachyte helps retailers personalize product search, recommendations, and merchandising using continuously updated shopper behavior.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its audience as retailers and its offering as unified search, recommendations, and merchandising. Its CEO explains that continuously updated shopper profiles power experiences that adapt during the visit.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link, and the checked pricing URL yielded no public page. The company analysis also reports that no rate-card pricing is published. This supports a negative answer rather than treating undisclosed prices alone as decisive.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Malachyte’s homepage presents FUN.com and BRUNT Workwear with links to their customer case studies. | named_customers.0: FUN.com is shown with a link to its customer case study. | named_customers.1: BRUNT Workwear is shown with a link to its customer case study.

employee_band.notes: The reported count of 17 employees falls within the requested 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies New York City as Malachyte’s location. | hq_country: The company profile lists Malachyte’s location as New York City, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook explicitly states that Malachyte was founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains predominantly product, commerce-strategy, funding, and marketing posts, with one clearly build-oriented Google Cloud article. The CTO’s founding post presents product principles rather than substantive implementation details. The index does not establish two qualifying engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The public help center links to documentation covering 148 articles, and the documentation index provides multiple product guides, including overview, portal basics, and brands/subdomains.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers index explicitly says there are no open positions. An isolated data/backend-engineering page would not qualify as an AI/ML role under the requested title rules.

model_provider.notes: In the CEO interview, Malachyte explicitly says it uses its own proprietary two-headed transformer, with a slower taste model and a continuously fine-tuned session component.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Malachyte’s technology page claims SOC II–Type 1 certification, normalized here as SOC 2 (Type I). | compliance_certs.0: The technology page explicitly claims SOC II–Type 1 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding announcement explicitly identifies the round as seed funding. | funding_date: The funding announcement is dated August 6, 2026, giving the requested month value 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The dated company announcement states that Malachyte closed a $10 million seed round, the latest identified funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round announced on August 6, 2026 falls within the requested eighteen-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers index explicitly states that there are no open positions, supporting no current SDR, BDR, or account-executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and company posts did not identify a qualifying launch announcement inside the six-month window. The explicit shipping statement located is dated August 4, 2025. An August 2026 interview mentions Merchandising Studio as an addition but does not establish its release date, so it was not counted as an in-window launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alexander Khan’s profile lists his VP, GTM role at Malachyte beginning in March 2026, within the requested twelve-month window.
